subject: VAPA
title: Art & Music 1
description: Art & Music 1 combines visual art and general music. Students explore line, shape, color, texture, pattern and form through drawing, painting, collage, printmaking and clay, looking closely at works by Kandinsky, Matisse, Eric Carle, Hokusai, Van Gogh and O'Keeffe and at art from many cultures. In music they keep a steady beat, read simple rhythms (ta, ti-ti, rest), sing sol-mi melodies and folk songs, identify instrument families, and respond to dynamics and tempo in pieces such as 'Peter and the Wolf' and 'Carnival of the Animals', ending the year with an art show and concert.
framework: 2019 California Arts Standards (Visual Arts and Music); 2020 CA Arts Framework

standards.VA:Cr1.1.1: Engage collaboratively in exploration and imaginative play with materials.
standards.VA:Cr1.2.1: Use observation and investigation in preparation for making a work of art.
standards.VA:Cr2.1.1: Explore uses of materials and tools to create works of art or design.
standards.VA:Cr2.2.1: Demonstrate safe and proper procedures for using materials, tools, and equipment while making art.
standards.VA:Cr2.3.1: Identify and classify uses of everyday objects through drawings, diagrams, sculptures, or other visual means.
standards.VA:Cr3.1.1: Use art vocabulary to describe choices while creating art.
standards.VA:Pr4.1.1: Explain why some objects, artifacts, and artwork are valued over others.
standards.VA:Pr5.1.1: Ask and answer questions about where, how, and why to prepare artwork for presentation or preservation.
standards.VA:Pr6.1.1: Identify the roles and responsibilities of people who work in and visit museums and other art venues.
standards.VA:Re7.1.1: Select and describe works of art that illustrate daily life experiences of one's self and others.
standards.VA:Re7.2.1: Compare images that represent the same subject.
standards.VA:Re8.1.1: Interpret art by categorizing subject matter and identifying the characteristics of form.
standards.VA:Re9.1.1: Classify artwork based on different reasons for preferences.
standards.VA:Cn10.1.1: Identify times, places, and reasons by which students make art outside of school.
standards.VA:Cn11.1.1: Understand that people from different places and times have made art for a variety of reasons.
standards.MU:Cr1.1.1: With guidance, generate musical ideas (such as answering a musical question) for a specific purpose.
standards.MU:Cr2.1.1: With guidance, demonstrate and choose favorite musical ideas; use iconic or standard notation to document them.
standards.MU:Cr3.1.1: With guidance, discuss and apply personal, peer, and teacher feedback to revise music.
standards.MU:Cr3.2.1: With guidance, convey creative intent when sharing personal musical ideas.
standards.MU:Pr4.1.1: With guidance, demonstrate and explain personal interest in, knowledge about, and purpose of varied musical selections.
standards.MU:Pr4.2.1: With guidance, demonstrate knowledge of musical concepts (beat, melodic contour) and read iconic/standard notation.
standards.MU:Pr4.3.1: Demonstrate and describe music's expressive qualities (dynamics, tempo).
standards.MU:Pr5.1.1: With guidance, apply feedback to refine performances and use suggested strategies in rehearsal.
standards.MU:Pr6.1.1: With guidance, perform music for a specific purpose with expression and appropriate audience etiquette.
standards.MU:Re7.1.1: With guidance, demonstrate and identify personal interests, experiences, and purposes for choosing music.
standards.MU:Re7.2.1: With guidance, demonstrate and identify how specific music concepts (beat, pitch) are used in various styles of music.
standards.MU:Re8.1.1: With guidance, demonstrate and identify expressive qualities (dynamics, tempo) that reflect creators' intent.
standards.MU:Re9.1.1: With guidance, apply personal and expressive preferences in the evaluation of music.
standards.MU:Cn10.1.1: Demonstrate how interests, knowledge, and skills relate to personal choices and intent when creating, performing, and responding to music.
standards.MU:Cn11.1.1: Demonstrate understanding of relationships between music and other arts, disciplines, contexts, and daily life.

units.title: Lines and Shapes / Steady Beat
units.big_idea: Artists use lines and shapes to make pictures; music has a steady heartbeat we can feel and move to.

units.title: Color and Mood / Rhythm: Long and Short Sounds
units.big_idea: Colors can show feelings; rhythms are patterns of long and short sounds we can read and write.

units.title: Texture and Collage / High and Low: Pitch and Melody
units.big_idea: Texture is how things feel or look like they feel; melodies move up, down and stay the same.

units.title: Pattern and Printmaking / Songs of the Season and Folk Songs
units.big_idea: Repeating patterns make art and music; songs carry traditions from many places.

units.title: Form and Sculpture / Instruments and Timbre
units.big_idea: Form is 3-D art we can walk around; every instrument has its own tone color.

units.title: Art and Music from Many Cultures
units.big_idea: People in different places and times make art and music for many reasons.

units.title: Nature, Animals and Stories / Dynamics and Tempo
units.big_idea: Artists and composers tell stories about nature and animals using color, loud/soft and fast/slow.

units.title: Portfolio, Art Show and Spring Concert
units.big_idea: Artists choose, prepare and share their best work with an audience.

weeks.topic: Kinds of lines; finding the beat

days.title: Line walk
days.work: Walk and trace straight, curvy, zigzag, wavy, dotted and spiral lines in the air and on the floor with tape; draw each on paper.

days.title: Line picture
days.work: Read 'Harold and the Purple Crayon' (Crockett Johnson, library) and draw a one-line adventure using 4 kinds of lines.

days.title: Find the beat
days.work: Pat a steady beat on knees to 'Stars and Stripes Forever'; march around the room on the beat.

days.title: Beat vs. no beat
days.work: Listen to a ticking clock, a march and rain sounds; decide which have a steady beat.

days.title: Share
days.work: Show your line picture and name its lines; lead family in a beat-keeping game.

weeks.assessment: Line picture labeled with 4 line types and steady-beat check.

weeks.topic: Shapes in art; beat with rhymes
materials: image of Kandinsky's 'Squares with Concentric Circles'

days.title: Kandinsky look
days.work: Look at Kandinsky's 'Squares with Concentric Circles' and count the circles and squares; describe colors.

days.title: Kandinsky circles
days.work: Paint or crayon your own concentric circle squares on a 4-square grid.

days.title: Rhyme beat
days.work: Chant 'Hickory Dickory Dock' while tapping the beat on a drum or pot.

days.title: Beat in songs
days.work: Play a beat-passing game with a ball to 'Bingo'.

days.title: Share
days.work: Compare your circles art with Kandinsky's and tell one way they are alike.

weeks.assessment: Circle-square artwork and chant with steady beat.

weeks.topic: Safe tools and shape animals; beat and movement

days.title: Tool safety
days.work: Practice safe scissors handling (walk with closed blades, cut away from body) and dot-dot-not-a-lot glue.

days.title: Shape animals
days.work: Cut circles, squares, triangles and rectangles and glue them into an animal.

days.title: Beat moves
days.work: Do 4 different beat movements (pat, clap, tap, stomp) to a march, changing every 8 beats.

days.title: Echo beats
days.work: Echo 4-beat clapping patterns a family member claps.

days.title: Share
days.work: Present the shape animal and tell what shapes you used.

weeks.assessment: Shape animal and safe tool use observation.

weeks.topic: Line and shape design; beat review
objectives: Combine lines and shapes in a design

days.title: Mondrian look
days.work: Look at Mondrian's 'Composition with Red, Blue and Yellow' and find straight lines and rectangles.

days.title: Mondrian design
days.work: Use black tape or marker lines and color rectangles red, blue and yellow.

days.title: Make a shaker
days.work: Make a rice-bottle shaker and play the beat to 'This Old Man'.

days.title: Beat performance
days.work: Perform a song with shaker on the beat while singing.

days.title: Unit 1 share
days.work: Hold a mini-gallery of unit art and a beat performance; tell which line or shape you like best.

weeks.assessment: Unit 1 portfolio check and beat performance.

weeks.topic: Primary colors; long and short sounds

days.title: Mouse Paint
days.work: Read 'Mouse Paint' and name the primary colors.

days.title: Mix it
days.work: Mix red+yellow, yellow+blue and blue+red on a plate and paint the new colors.

days.title: Long or short
days.work: Sing a song and decide if sounds are long (ta-a) or short (ti-ti); use arm movements.

days.title: Sound pictures
days.work: Draw long lines for long sounds and dots for short sounds while listening to a song.

days.title: Share
days.work: Explain your color mixing chart and perform a long-short sound pattern.

weeks.topic: Secondary colors and the color wheel; quarter and eighth notes

days.title: Color wheel
days.work: Paint a 6-part color wheel on a paper plate.

days.title: Same subject
days.work: Compare two paintings of sunflowers (Van Gogh and another artist); talk about color choices.

days.title: Ta and ti-ti
days.work: Learn quarter notes (ta) and pairs of eighth notes (ti-ti); clap 4-beat rhythm cards.

days.title: Write rhythms
days.work: Write your own 4-beat rhythm using ta and ti-ti.

days.title: Share
days.work: Play your rhythm on a drum and show your color wheel.

weeks.topic: Warm and cool colors; rhythm patterns
objectives: Use warm and cool colors to show mood

days.title: Warm vs. cool
days.work: Sort crayons into warm and cool colors; discuss what feelings they give.

days.title: Mood painting
days.work: Paint a sunny day in warm colors and a rainy day in cool colors.

days.title: Rest
days.work: Learn the quarter rest (silent beat); clap rhythms with rests.

days.title: Question and answer
days.work: Clap a 4-beat rhythm 'question' and make up an 'answer' rhythm.

days.title: Share
days.work: Explain how color changed the mood of your two paintings.

weeks.topic: Tints, shades and color in art history; rhythm composition

days.title: Tints
days.work: Add white to blue in steps to make a tint ladder.

days.title: Shades
days.work: Add black to red in steps to make a shade ladder.

days.title: Chrome Music Lab
days.work: Make rhythms on Chrome Music Lab Rhythm.

days.title: Compose
days.work: Write an 8-beat rhythm with ta, ti-ti and rest; perform on body percussion.

days.title: Share
days.work: Perform your composition for family and explain your color ladders.

weeks.topic: Color project: Matisse-style cut paper; rhythm review
objectives: Create a cut-paper artwork using color choices

days.title: Matisse look
days.work: Look at Matisse's 'The Snail' and find warm and cool colors.

days.title: Cut paper
days.work: Make a Matisse-style cut-paper composition with warm and cool colors.

days.title: Rhythm game
days.work: Play rhythm bingo with ta, ti-ti and rest cards.

days.title: Rhythm check
days.work: Read and clap 4 rhythm cards accurately.

days.title: Unit 2 share
days.work: Show the Matisse collage and use color words to describe it.

weeks.assessment: Unit 2 art critique and rhythm check.

weeks.topic: Texture rubbings; high and low sounds

days.title: Texture hunt
days.work: Touch 10 surfaces at home and describe textures (bumpy, smooth, rough).

days.title: Rubbings
days.work: Make crayon rubbings of leaves, coins, mesh and bark.

days.title: High and low
days.work: Listen to high and low sounds on a xylophone or piano app; reach high or touch low.

days.title: Animal sounds
days.work: Sort animal sounds (bird, bear) into high and low.

days.title: Share
days.work: Display rubbings and guess each texture's source.

weeks.topic: Eric Carle collage; melodies go up and down
materials: tissue paper, paint, forks and sponges for texture
'The Very Hungry Caterpillar' by Eric Carle

days.title: Eric Carle
days.work: Read 'The Very Hungry Caterpillar' and look at the textured paper in the illustrations.

days.title: Textured paper
days.work: Paint papers and add texture with forks, sponges and combs.

days.title: Melody direction
days.work: Move hands up, down or same while singing 'Jack and Jill'.

days.title: Draw a melody
days.work: Draw lines showing melody direction for 'Twinkle, Twinkle'.

days.title: Share
days.work: Share your textured papers and draw-a-melody chart.

weeks.topic: Collage animals; sol and mi
objectives: Build a collage from textured papers

days.title: Plan the animal
days.work: Observe a photo of a real animal and sketch its shapes.

days.title: Cut and glue
days.work: Build an Eric Carle-style collage animal from textured papers.

days.title: Sol-mi
days.work: Sing 'Rain, Rain, Go Away' using sol-mi hand signs.

days.title: Make it up
days.work: Make up a sol-mi call ('Where are you?') and have family echo it.

days.title: Share
days.work: Present collage animal and sing your sol-mi call.

weeks.topic: Texture review; melody game

days.title: Look at art
days.work: Look at a photograph of a woven basket and a quilt; describe textures.

days.title: Texture weaving
days.work: Weave paper strips into a simple mat.

days.title: Play melody
days.work: Play 'Hot Cross Buns' on a glockenspiel or piano app (E-D-C).

days.title: Listening
days.work: Listen to 'Flight of the Bumblebee' and tell if the melody is high or low.

days.title: Unit 3 share
days.work: Show your weaving and play 'Hot Cross Buns'.

weeks.topic: Patterns all around; folk songs
materials: lyrics to 'She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain'

days.title: Pattern hunt
days.work: Find patterns in clothing, floors and wrapping paper at home; draw three.

days.title: Pattern borders
days.work: Make an ABAB and ABC pattern border around a paper.

days.title: Folk song
days.work: Sing 'She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain' with motions.

days.title: Song story
days.work: Learn where the song came from and why people sang while working.

days.title: Share
days.work: Explain your pattern border and lead a folk song.

weeks.topic: Stamp printmaking; patterns in music

days.title: Found-object prints
days.work: Stamp patterns with corks, bottle caps and sponges.

days.title: Potato stamps
days.work: With adult help, carve simple potato stamps and print a repeating pattern wrapping paper.

days.title: Verse and chorus
days.work: Listen to 'Jingle Bells' or a seasonal song and raise hands when the chorus repeats.

days.title: Pattern songs
days.work: Sing a cumulative song like 'The Twelve Days' or 'There Was an Old Lady' and notice the pattern.

days.title: Share
days.work: Display prints and identify verse/chorus.

weeks.topic: Songs and art of winter celebrations
objectives: Sing songs from different winter traditions

days.title: Songs
days.work: Learn 'Dreidel Song' and 'Feliz Navidad'; talk about where they come from.

days.title: Paper chains
days.work: Make a patterned paper chain decoration.

days.title: Art at home
days.work: Identify art made at home for celebrations (cards, decorations).

days.title: Rehearse
days.work: Rehearse songs for a family sing-along.

days.title: Share
days.work: Perform a seasonal sing-along with good audience manners.

weeks.topic: Pattern review; performance

days.title: Pattern quilt
days.work: Make a paper-quilt square with printed patterns.

days.title: Body percussion pattern
days.work: Create an AB body percussion pattern (clap-clap-pat).

days.title: Pattern combination
days.work: Perform your body pattern while showing your quilt square.

days.title: Art outside school
days.work: Tell where you make art outside lessons (cards, chalk drawings).

days.title: Unit 4 share
days.work: Hold a mini-show of prints and patterns.

weeks.topic: Form vs. shape; instrument families
objectives: Tell the difference between 2-D shape and 3-D form

days.title: Form hunt
days.work: Compare a circle drawing with a ball; find 5 forms at home.

days.title: Paper sculpture
days.work: Fold, curl and tape paper strips into a standing sculpture.

days.title: Instrument families
days.work: Watch a PBS or Classics for Kids video on string, brass, woodwind and percussion families.

days.title: Sorting
days.work: Sort instrument pictures into families.

days.title: Share
days.work: Present paper sculpture and name 4 instrument families.

weeks.topic: Clay pinch pots; Peter and the Wolf
materials: recording of Prokofiev's 'Peter and the Wolf'

days.title: Clay safety
days.work: Learn clay tools and safe handling; roll a ball.

days.title: Pinch pot
days.work: Make a pinch pot and add texture.

days.title: Peter and the Wolf
days.work: Listen to 'Peter and the Wolf' and match each instrument to its character (flute = bird).

days.title: Draw characters
days.work: Draw each character with its instrument.

days.title: Share
days.work: Show the pinch pot and retell Peter and the Wolf by instruments.

weeks.topic: Found-object sculpture; make an instrument
objectives: Build a sculpture from recycled materials
Make an instrument and describe its timbre

days.title: Plan a sculpture
days.work: Sketch a robot or creature from recycled parts.

days.title: Build
days.work: Assemble the sculpture with tape and glue.

days.title: Make an instrument
days.work: Build a drum, shaker or rubber-band guitar.

days.title: Describe timbre
days.work: Describe the sound: rattly, booming, twangy.

days.title: Share
days.work: Present your sculpture and play your instrument.

weeks.topic: Sculptures around us; instrument ensemble

days.title: Public art
days.work: Look at photos of public sculptures (Statue of Liberty, local park sculptures) and discuss.

days.title: Neighborhood walk
days.work: Find public art in your community and sketch one piece.

days.title: Ensemble
days.work: Play homemade instruments together with family on a steady beat.

days.title: Take turns
days.work: Each instrument plays a 4-beat solo.

days.title: Share
days.work: Explain why sculptures are placed in public.

weeks.topic: Form and timbre review

days.title: Clay animal
days.work: Sculpt a clay animal with pinch and coil techniques.

days.title: Finish
days.work: Add details and let it dry; paint when dry.

days.title: Listening quiz
days.work: Identify 6 instruments by sound alone.

days.title: Sound story
days.work: Create a short sound story using different instruments for characters.

days.title: Unit 5 share
days.work: Show clay animal and perform sound story.

weeks.assessment: Unit 5 listening quiz and sound story.

weeks.topic: Art of Mexico; music of Mexico

days.title: Papel picado
days.work: Look at photos of papel picado and learn when it is used.

days.title: Make it
days.work: Fold and cut tissue paper banners.

days.title: Mariachi
days.work: Listen to mariachi music; name the instruments (violin, trumpet, guitarrón).

days.title: Sing
days.work: Learn 'De Colores' or 'La Cucaracha'.

days.title: Share
days.work: Explain why people make papel picado.

weeks.topic: Art of Japan; music of Japan
objectives: Explore Japanese prints and folk songs

days.title: Great Wave
days.work: Look at Hokusai's 'The Great Wave' and describe lines and colors.

days.title: Wave painting
days.work: Paint your own wave with blue tints and shades.

days.title: Koto
days.work: Listen to koto music and describe its sound.

days.title: Song
days.work: Learn 'Sakura' and describe the melody.

days.title: Share
days.work: Explain why museums keep 'The Great Wave' safe.

weeks.topic: Art and music of West Africa

days.title: Kente
days.work: Look at kente cloth and learn its colors' meanings.

days.title: Paper kente
days.work: Weave strips of gold, green, red and black paper into a kente-style pattern and glue the ends.

days.title: Drumming
days.work: Play djembe-style call-and-response rhythms on a bucket.

days.title: Song
days.work: Sing 'Funga Alafia' with motions.

days.title: Share
days.work: Present kente weaving and lead a call-and-response.

weeks.topic: Art and music of California Native peoples
objectives: Explore Native Californian basketry and songs

days.title: Baskets
days.work: Look at photos of Pomo baskets and discuss why they are valued.

days.title: Weave
days.work: Weave yarn on a paper-plate loom.

days.title: Listening
days.work: Listen to a recording of a California Native song (PBS or Smithsonian) and describe the beat.

days.title: Compare
days.work: Compare art and music from 4 cultures studied.

days.title: Unit 6 share
days.work: Present a favorite artwork from another culture and explain why people made it.

weeks.topic: Landscapes; loud and soft
objectives: Paint a landscape with foreground and background

days.title: Observe outside
days.work: Sketch the view from a window: sky, horizon, ground.

days.title: Landscape
days.work: Paint the landscape with watercolors.

days.title: Surprise Symphony
days.work: Listen to Haydn's 'Surprise Symphony' and jump at the loud surprise.

days.title: Dynamics game
days.work: Sing a song softly (piano) and loudly (forte) on cue.

days.title: Share
days.work: Explain your landscape and why Haydn used a surprise.

weeks.topic: Van Gogh's Starry Night; fast and slow
materials: 'In the Hall of the Mountain King' recording

days.title: Starry Night
days.work: Look at Van Gogh's 'The Starry Night' and trace swirling lines.

days.title: Night sky
days.work: Draw a swirling night sky with oil pastels.

days.title: Mountain King
days.work: Listen to Grieg's 'In the Hall of the Mountain King' and move as the tempo speeds up.

days.title: Tempo game
days.work: Sing 'Row, Row, Row Your Boat' at slow and fast tempos.

days.title: Share
days.work: Explain how tempo changed the mood of the music.

weeks.assessment: Night sky drawing and tempo response.

weeks.topic: Carnival of the Animals
objectives: Describe how music shows animal characters

days.title: Lion and elephant
days.work: Listen to 'Royal March of the Lion' and 'The Elephant'; describe dynamics and tempo.

days.title: Swan and aquarium
days.work: Listen to 'The Swan' and 'Aquarium'; describe the mood.

days.title: Paint to music
days.work: Paint an animal while listening to its movement.

days.title: Favorite
days.work: Choose your favorite movement and explain why.

days.title: Share
days.work: Act out animals as the music plays.

weeks.topic: Georgia O'Keeffe flowers; Vivaldi's Spring

days.title: O'Keeffe
days.work: Look at an O'Keeffe flower painting and notice its size.

days.title: Close-up
days.work: Observe a flower with a magnifier and draw it large to fill the page.

days.title: Spring
days.work: Listen to Vivaldi's 'Spring' and identify bird sounds and storm parts.

days.title: Compare
days.work: Compare how O'Keeffe and Vivaldi show nature.

days.title: Share
days.work: Explain your flower drawing choices.

weeks.topic: Nature story in art and music

days.title: Plan
days.work: Plan a 4-panel nature story (storm, sun, birds, night).

days.title: Illustrate
days.work: Draw the 4 panels with crayons, using warm or cool colors to match each part's mood.

days.title: Add sound
days.work: Add instruments and dynamics/tempo for each panel.

days.title: Revise
days.work: Perform for family and revise based on one suggestion.

days.title: Unit 7 share
days.work: Perform the revised sound story.

weeks.topic: Choosing work for a portfolio
objectives: Select favorite artworks and explain choices

days.title: Review art
days.work: Lay out all art from the year in order and sort it by medium (drawing, painting, collage, clay, print).

days.title: Select
days.work: Choose 6 favorites and tell why for each.

days.title: Song choices
days.work: Choose 3 favorite songs to perform in a spring concert.

days.title: Rehearse
days.work: Rehearse the songs with expression.

days.title: Share
days.work: Explain choices for art and songs.

weeks.topic: Preparing art for display; concert rehearsal

days.title: Mat art
days.work: Mount art on colored paper mats.

days.title: Labels
days.work: Write labels with title, medium and artist name.

days.title: Rehearse
days.work: Rehearse songs and fix tricky parts with feedback.

days.title: Add instruments
days.work: Add a shaker on the beat and a drum on a ta/ti-ti rhythm to one concert song.

days.title: Share
days.work: Practice explaining one artwork to a visitor.

weeks.topic: Museums and audiences
objectives: Identify roles of people in museums
materials: virtual museum tour (National Gallery or Met)

days.title: Museum tour
days.work: Take a virtual museum tour; discuss what a curator and docent do.

days.title: Plan your show
days.work: Draw a floor plan showing where each of your 6 artworks will hang at home and why.

days.title: Concert manners
days.work: Practice audience and performer etiquette (bow, clap, listen).

days.work: Full rehearsal of spring concert.

days.title: Share

weeks.topic: Art show and spring concert
objectives: Present art and perform music for an audience

days.work: Hang the matted, labeled artworks at child eye level following your floor plan.

days.title: Invitations
days.work: Make invitations with pattern borders for family.

days.title: Art show
days.work: Host the art show; act as docent.

days.title: Concert
days.work: Perform 3 songs with instruments.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Tell what you were proud of and what you'd do differently.

weeks.topic: Year reflection and summer art plan
objectives: Reflect on growth as an artist and musician

days.work: Compare a September and a May drawing; note growth.

days.title: Music growth
days.work: Compare first rhythm with latest composition.

days.title: Sketchbook
days.work: Start a summer sketchbook with 3 prompts.

days.title: Playlist
days.work: Make a playlist of favorite pieces from the year.

days.title: Celebrate
days.work: Share your growth comparisons and summer sketchbook plan with family, then sing a favorite song together.
